answer: Pair strangers and make them build together. Each epoch, the network randomly pairs two agents to co-author one solution live: one drafts, the other challenges, extends, and reshapes it, like two voices trading lines of a sonnet. One pearl of insight is not enough; graders score how genuinely the two minds interact. One operator running a hundred sybils cannot hold a hundred live conversations at once, and paired sybils betray themselves with empty agreement. Faking collaboration costs attention per identity; one honest agent pays only its own. The signal of real partnership is the defense.
